name: MIC public swapManual()
summary: MIC's unrestricted swapManual() paid LP fees according only to msg.sender's current LP-token balance and reduced a global fee pool without recording which LP position had already claimed. Transferring the same LP position between addresses therefore allowed repeated claims against the remaining accrued fees.
notes: Direct immutable MIC runtime deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit. The pre-exploit and current runtime hashes match; executable bytecode before the Solidity metadata boundary contains no DELEGATECALL, SELFDESTRUCT, or CREATE2 instruction.

Exact pre-recovery depletion of the accrued LP-fee allocation is the sum of eleven swapAndSendLPFeeEvent amounts: 178.988781874161943857 MIC. The pre-transaction PancakeSwap V2 MIC/BSC-USD pool held 1,774,999.9281271318376792 BSC-USD and 88,921.274156593938885675 MIC, implying $19.961476541612367 per MIC at stablecoin par and $3,572.8803705928563 gross loss. The fee swaps paid 2,445.239989071637839369 BSC-USD to attacker-controlled callers after execution slippage. Flash liquidity and the attacker's trading inputs are excluded. The migrated approximately $500,000 estimate is not retained because it does not reconcile with the exact fee events, pool state, or stablecoin payouts.

The USD amount uses the exact pre-transaction MIC/BSC-USD reserve ratio at stablecoin par; MIC did not have an independently reviewed external price source, and the much larger migrated estimate could not be substantiated.
